methodology.opponentSampling: Same 60 widely distributed uint32 seeds for each composition; random distinct enemy definitions, same rank, 1 star.
methodology.timeout: Battle reaches 32-round limit; outcome compares remaining HP ratios.
methodology.deadlock: A full round consists only of blocked zero-distance walks and has no attack or blink.
methodology.shieldStall: Timed out with zero HP damage across the final 8 complete rounds.
methodology.repeatingTail: Final two end-of-round state cycles match exactly; signature includes HP/shield/energy/positions.
changes: 只有实际HP损失>0才获得受击10能量。
坦克全部盾系数乘0.65，双坦克生命加成15%降至8%。
第17轮起，每轮累计伤害+8%、新盾-5%，新盾最低20%。
职业基础HP/攻击/护甲/法抗/射程未改。
methodology.caveat: 固定6人口/永久Lv1/局内1星的随机敌阵冒烟，不是正式平衡结论。
